CREATE TABLE [dbo].[central_employees] (
    [id] NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
    [sap_number] INT NOT NULL,
    [first_name] NVARCHAR(1000),
    [surname] NVARCHAR(1000),
    [name] NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
    [email] NVARCHAR(1000),
    [org_unit_id] NVARCHAR(1000),
    [active] BIT NOT NULL,
    [created_at] DATETIME2 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [central_employees_created_at_df] DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    [updated_at] DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [central_employees_pkey] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([id]),
    CONSTRAINT [central_employees_sap_number_key] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ([sap_number])
);
